technical_data.url_obfuscation: Domain uses 'corp-secure.net' to appear as an internal corporate service but is a recently registered external domain with privacy protection. The URL mimics legitimate password reset links with parameters to lure the victim.

indicators: Recently registered domain corp-secure.net with privacy protection
Email originates from unfamiliar IP 192.0.2.210
Use of recipient's real name and executive position in email body
Urgent password reset request with suspicious URL parameters
DKIM signature does not align with corporate domains
samples.detection_method: Enforce strict SPF/DKIM/DMARC policies, use URL reputation and domain age filters, verify password reset requests through secondary authentication, and educate executives on phishing tactics.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1592.001 - Gather Victim Identity Information: Social Media
